title: Impl: Python ForwardingBuffer reads size from NodeClass
description: Modify ForwardingBuffer.__init__ in python/src/lichen/link/forwarding_buffer.py to accept node_class parameter. Read max_sources and per_source_limit from NODE_CLASS_PARAMS[node_class] instead of hardcoded values. Default to NodeClass.ROUTER for backward compat. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_forward*.py -x
